mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which can prolong QT interval and increase fexofenadine's cardiac risk through reduced renal clearance and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes closely during concurrent use; consider alternative antihistamine if possible; maintain aggressive electrolyte repletion during amphotericin B therapy.
